اختطيتم (form VIII)
# اِخْتَطَيْتُمْ (iḵtaṭaytum) /ix.ta.tˤaj.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
# اُخْتُطِيتُمْ (uḵtuṭītum) /ux.tu.tˤiː.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِخْتَطَى (iḵtaṭā)
